name: IAC Forgeheart / Anvil Landing 16 km authored terrace

features.terrace: engineered 1.52 x 1.56 km port terrace cut into the basin
features.cut: retaining wall/berm and 200 m graded cut around the terrace
features.road: 13 m service road descending from the south wall gap into the basin
features.riverbed: dry braided river/wash west of the terrace
features.gullies: two eroded gullies feeding the basin
features.ridges: 760 m north foundry ridge, east scarp, south mesas, 570 m west rim

license: project-owned procedural heightfield; detail textures from the existing project terrain sample
